note: FINDING 2026-11-09: bg_watch.py (stalled-bg report) and host_health.py (reap orphan gates, report strays) exist and work, but run only when a session calls supervisor.py plan or sync.py ship/health. No scheduled task runs them, bg_watch is read-only (cannot stop a shell; only the owning session can), and the 12h shell was never flagged because nobody ran them in that window. Fix: run bg_watch on a timer (Task Scheduler) and write STALLED-BG to the desk/operator card; let the harness-owner session stop it, or add a safe kill for shells past 2x cap. Not a twin of coordinator-sits-idle-during-long-backgr.
result: Repro: a cat heredoc as a background shell exits at once here (exit 0); the 12 h hang was a harness shell that never exited, not reproducible from the command. Root cause of 'unnoticed': bg_watch (STALLED-BG/GHOST-BG/OLD-SHELL, shells --kill) and the WORKERS.md 30-min rule already existed (4498f4672) but nothing in boot/health showed live old shells; supervisor.py plan only runs for coordinators. Extended, not duplicated: sync.py health now prints NOTE OLD-SHELL from bg_watch.live_shells (test_old_shell_health.py, registered in extra_tests.tsv; test_bg_watch covers the lister).
